elements.text:
A cache is just a temporary storage that keeps recently used data handy so you can get it much faster

When most engineers hear caching, they immediately think of Redis or Memcached sitting between the application
and the database. It is the most common type of cache and the one interviewers care about the most.

elements.text:
A CDN is a geographically distributed network of servers that caches content close to users.
Instead of every request travelling to your origin server, A CDN stores copies of your content.

elements.text:
Fix

- Request Coalescing [Single Flight]: Allow only one request to rebuild the
cache while others wait for result. Merge identical concurrent in-flight
requests into a single backend call.

- Cache Warming: Refresh popular keys proactively before they expire. This
one helps when using TTL-based expiration.
